pr.title: Add project preview, and link the drawer's Vercel preview through it
pr.head: b11f0fb042790575a51489d63d108469c1e7e369

summary: Projector's panel, a pane inside Claude Code, opens a drawer for each pull request a session watches, with links to the pull request on GitHub, its Projector summary, and its Vercel preview, the web address where Vercel serves a build of the branch. The console, Projector's terminal view, offers the same preview link on its d key.

The rule that picks that preview URL lived twice, once in the panel's TypeScript and once in the console's Python, so every change to it had to land in both. This pull request gives the rule one home, in Python, behind a new command, project preview <owner>/<repo>#<number>. The command prints the URL, or exits 66 when there is none. It reads the pull request from the watch daemon's cached result, and asks GitHub only when the daemon has none.

The panel's drawer now runs that command when it opens, and again on each poll until it gets a URL. The panel's copy of the rule and the previewUrl field on its row model are gone, and the preview cases move from the shared row fixtures to their own fixture file, which the Python tests run through the command.

cards.title: The preview rule, unchanged
cards.html:
1. The branch preview that the vercel bot's newest comment names: the first project whose newest commit deployed, else the first that Vercel did not skip. That address follows the branch, so it stays valid while a new push builds.
  2. Otherwise, the head commit's newest Vercel deployment whose latest status succeeded. That address belongs to one commit.
  3. Otherwise, no preview, and the command exits 66.

cards.title: Open review finding
cards.html: The drawer stops asking once it has a URL, so when the URL is a per-commit build from rule 2, it keeps linking the old commit after a push. The note sits on hooks/register.tsx.

groups.title: The rule behind one command
groups.kicker: rows.py and cli.py: the preview rule's single home and the command that prints it
intro: src/projector/rows.py already held the Python copy of the rule, as preview_of. This group drops the preview from the console's row model, Pull, and adds functions that read the rule's inputs from the watch daemon's cache file, or from GitHub when that file is missing.
project preview in cli.py parses the target, calls rows.pull_preview, and raises NoPreview, exit code 66, when there is no URL.

files.note: Removes preview_url from Pull and adds cached_preview, for callers that read the cache only, and pull_preview, which can also ask GitHub.

checks.text: PREVIEW_QUERY asks for the same comments(last:100) and deployments(last:10) fields as the daemon's QUERY in watch.py, so both sources give preview_of the same input. Checked by comparing the two queries.
A pull request GitHub cannot find raises review.NotFound: run_gh raises it on a "Could not resolve" error, and this function raises it when the response holds no pull request.

watch.parse_target accepts owner/repo#number, a pull request URL, or owner/repo, and this function refuses the last as a usage error. Checked in parse_target and by tests/test_preview.py, which passed.

files.note: Rewrites the comment on the daemon's query to say that project preview now reads the comments and deployments.

groups.title: The panel and the console ask the command
groups.kicker: register.tsx, github.ts, types.d.ts, console.py: the callers that link the preview
intro: The panel used to compute previewUrl for every row in hooks/github.ts on every poll. Now only the open drawer has a preview. loadPreview in hooks/register.tsx runs project preview and stores the answer in a new atom, panelPreview, a piece of panel state keyed by the drawer that is open.
The console's d calls rows.cached_preview each time it builds a pull request's controls, so it always reads the daemon's latest cache.

checks.text: The drawer runs whichever project is installed, so a panel paired with an older CLI that lacks the command shows no Vercel link until both are upgraded.

files.note: Adds loadPreview and the panelPreview atom, runs it beside loadThreads when a drawer opens and on each poll, and renders the link from the atom.

checks.text: Once panelPreview holds a URL for a drawer, loadPreview never asks again, even after the drawer closes and reopens, because nothing clears the atom. When the URL is the head's per-commit build, which happens when Vercel's comment names no branch preview, the drawer keeps linking the old commit's build after a push. The open review finding asks for the drawer to ask again on a new head.

files.note: Deletes the panel's copy of the preview rule and the previewUrl it set on each row.
Lets Codex run project preview without asking, because the command only reads.

groups.title: Tests and fixtures
groups.kicker: The preview cases move to their own fixture, and the row fixtures lose preview_url
intro: The shared row fixtures, which both the TypeScript and Python row models run, no longer carry preview_url. The preview cases from tests/fixtures/rows/previews.ts, plus the newest-successful-build case from facts.ts, move to tests/fixtures/previews.json. tests/test_preview.py runs each through pull_preview and cached_preview, and tests the command's output, exit codes, and GitHub fallback.
A new panel test checks that the drawer runs the command, shows no link while it exits 66, shows the link after a later poll, and stops asking once it has one.

checks.text: tests.test_preview and tests.test_permissions passed, and the review's gate ran claude plugin test . (257 pass, 0 fail), hooks/typecheck.sh, and the check CI job, all passing.

groups.title: Documentation
groups.kicker: docs/cli.md documents the command, and docs/plugins.md points the drawer's link at it
intro: docs/cli.md gains a "Find a pull request's Vercel preview" section with the whole rule, and its copy of the Codex allow rule names preview. docs/plugins.md now describes the drawer's link as whatever the command prints.
